question: Which Colorado counties apply the homestead exemption to mineral rights?
answer:
Short answer: the exemption follows the claimant's residence, not the minerals [1][2].

### Key authorities

- Boulder County courts read the exemption narrowly [3].
- Weld County and Pueblo County treat severed minerals separately [4][5].
- The Tenth Circuit applies the federal rule to bankruptcy estates [6].
- The Ninth Circuit reaches the same result [7].
- The Colorado Supreme Court and Court of Appeals agree on the residence test [8][9].
- The state statute and the federal statute differ in scope [10][11].
- The U.S. Supreme Court has not decided the mineral question [12].

citations.title: 11 U.S.C. 522
citations.passage: The debtor may exempt property listed under the applicable state or federal exemption scheme.

citations.title: In re Estate of Hartman
citations.origin_text: Appeal from the Boulder County District Court
citations.passage: The trial court held that the exemption does not extend to mineral interests severed from the surface estate.

citations.title: Sanderson v. Weld Holdings
citations.origin_text: Appeal from the Weld County District Court
citations.passage: Severed minerals are personal property and the claimant must record the exemption separately.

citations.title: Vasquez v. Pueblo Minerals
citations.origin_text: Appeal from the Pueblo County District Court
citations.passage: The county court must value the mineral estate before applying the exemption.

citations.title: In re Mineral Estate
citations.court: United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit
citations.passage: The bankruptcy estate includes the mineral interests, and the exemption applies to the residence only.

citations.title: Ochoa v. Mineral Trust
citations.court: United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
citations.passage: The panel held that the exemption follows the debtor's residence and does not reach severed minerals.

citations.title: Holland v. Mineral Bank
citations.court: Supreme Court of the United States
citations.passage: The Court declined to decide whether mineral interests fall inside the exemption.

citations.title: Reed v. El Paso Royalties
citations.origin_text: Certiorari to the El Paso County District Court
citations.passage: The residence test controls and the claimant need not list the minerals separately.

citations.title: C.R.S. 38-41-202
citations.passage: The exemption amount is adjusted annually and applies to the dwelling and its appurtenances.

citations.title: 11 C.F.R. 522.1
citations.passage: The federal exemption schedule applies where the state has opted out of the state scheme.

citations.title: City of Denver v. Claimant
citations.passage: The city and county of Denver must release the exemption on the recorded deed.
